source_evidence: You may prefer a wrap fee program if you prefer the certainty of a single fee for advisory services and commissions. You may pay other fees and costs related to services and investments.
question: Misconception: A wrap fee program’s single fee necessarily covers every fee and cost related to your services and investments.
answer: Correction: The summary describes a wrap fee as offering a single fee for advisory services and commissions, but it also notes that you may pay other fees and costs related to services and investments. Don’t assume the single fee covers every cost; check the relationship summary and your agreement for details.
